summary: RCA investigation and fix for Channel Preview card size not changing. Root cause: edits were applied to /app/guide-app/src/components/ChannelFeatured.jsx which is NOT served (no supervisor process for guide-app). The running app at port 3000 uses /app/frontend/src/components/ChannelFeatured.jsx which still had the old w-52 h-36 classes. Fixed by updating the correct file. Card is now confirmed 384x256px (w-96 h-64) in the live app.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Two duplicate ChannelFeatured.jsx files exist: /app/guide-app/src/components/ChannelFeatured.jsx and /app/frontend/src/components/ChannelFeatured.jsx. The guide-app is NOT a running service (no supervisor process). The main frontend (port 3000, served by supervisor) imports from /app/frontend/src/components/ChannelFeatured.jsx. The size change (w-52 h-36 -> w-96 h-64) was applied to the guide-app file, but the live app uses the frontend file which was untouched.
reproduction_steps: 3. The Channel Preview card top-left shows old size (208x144px / w-52 h-36)
4. This is because App.js imports ChannelFeatured from ./components/ChannelFeatured (frontend version)
5. The guide-app version at /app/guide-app/ is never served - supervisorctl shows no guide-app process
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Updated /app/frontend/src/components/ChannelFeatured.jsx: changed w-52 h-36 to w-96 h-64, rounded-xl to rounded-2xl, and updated interior text sizes (text-3xl to text-7xl for channel number, text-xs to text-base for channel name) to match the guide-app version.

critical_code_review_comments: DUPLICATE COMPONENTS: /app/guide-app/ and /app/frontend/ have duplicate ChannelFeatured.jsx, EPGGrid.jsx, Sidebar.jsx etc. The guide-app is never served as a standalone process — consider removing /app/guide-app/ or properly integrating it, to avoid future confusion about which file to edit.
DEAD CODE: /app/guide-app/ entire directory appears to be dead code since supervisor only runs /app/frontend/ on port 3000.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Channel Preview card size fix has been applied to /app/frontend/src/components/ChannelFeatured.jsx (w-96 h-64, 384x256px confirmed in browser). The guide-app at /app/guide-app/ is not a running service. The main app runs at port 3000 from /app/frontend/. No backend testing was performed as per instructions.
